# FDG8071

> DO override `GetHashCode` if you override `Object.Equals`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.2 Object.GetHashCode.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

The C# compiler reports a type that overrides Equals without GetHashCode (warning CS0659); compiler warnings are not in the SDK catalog, so the rule is judgment. FDG8064 is the same guideline in section 8.9.1.

## From the book

This guarantees that two objects considered equal have the same hash code. The following guidelines provide more information.
